d:
Bihar ke shivhar sthit dumri katasri prakhand antargat shyampur panchayat ke shyampur bajar men budhvar ko aitihasik rajyastariy dangal kushti pratiyogita ka bhavy aayojan kiya gaya. pratiyogita men desh ke vibhinn rajyon se pahunche namchin pahalvanon ne apni kushti kala aur damkham ka shandar pradarshan kiya.
